caveats_promoted.the_real_finding: caveat 2 IS the finding: the comparison as operationalized contrasts a THEOREM-COUPLED construction (census charges derived from one another by the dichotomies) against an EMPIRICAL population (canon charges from independent literature), so divergence was structurally likely regardless of what hardness is. k*=3 is the census re-expressing its own entailment, not emergent structure.
